what: axionFEM vs COMSOL (2022), shielded lossless solenoid of arXiv:2211.00008 (Model_File.mph)
conventions: COMSOL exp(+jwt): Im Z = +w L; axionFEM values conjugated. V_oc = Vport (Zport+50)/50. Psi sign fixed by the port orientation at the lowest sweep frequency. rel = (axionFEM - COMSOL)/|COMSOL|. COMSOL pole 'narrow' if its residue < 1e+08 ohm Hz.
